title: Top differentials extend into canonical modules on point blowups
statement: Let $p$ be prime, let $A$ be a regular local ring of dimension $2$ and characteristic $p$, and let $A_0\subseteq A$ be a subring such that $\Omega_{A/A_0}$ is finite free of rank $r\geq1$ [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Put $W=\bigwedge_A^r\Omega_{A/A_0}$, the quotient of the $r$th tensor power by the alternating relations. Let $b:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a finite sequence, possibly of length zero, of blowups at reduced closed points [def-nagata-global-blowup], [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Write $\omega_X$ for the canonical module normalized relative to $W[2]$ as in [lem-per-coherent-normal-surface-trace-calculus]. There is an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\varphi_X:(\Omega^r_{X/\operatorname{Spec}A_0})^{**}\to\omega_X$ extending the identity $\bigwedge_K^r\Omega_{K/\operatorname{Frac}(A_0)}=W\otimes_AK$ at $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$. Here relative differentials are [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf], $\Omega^r=\bigwedge^r\Omega$, and $M^{**}=\mathcal Hom(\mathcal Hom(M,\mathcal O_X),\mathcal O_X)$.
